question_text: Complete the following table with the information given in the passage.
stimulus: In the history of Indian religion, Buddhism occupies a unique place. Its founder was Buddha or Siddhartha. It is known that 487 B.C. was the date of birth of Buddha. Chandragupta Mourya ascended the throne sometimes after the death of Alexander and the first treaty of Babylon in 323 B.C. We can assume reasonably the accession of Chandragupta Mourya in about 323 B.С. According to the Purans, Chandragupta reigned for 24 years and his son Bindusara for 35 years. If we deduct the period of their reigns, Asoka could ascend the throne in about 273 B. C. Asoka's consecration took place after 4 years which comes to 269 B.C. This tallies with the view that Asoka was consecrated 218 years after the Nirvana. If we deduct 218 from 487, we arrive at the figure of 269. Under the circumstance, 487 B.C is taken to be the year of death of Buddha and if we deduct 80 years from 487, we will get the date of birth of Buddha because he died at the age of sixty.
